text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, today's the day I make all the 
other Umamusume believe in feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer☆ Just break it down and 
explain it simply!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey there, you♪ Your training just now 
was really great, but from a feng shui 
perspective, it was just slightly lacking, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Bringing good fortune"... In other words, 
to strengthen the power of the auspicious 
direction, maybe I should be more mindful 
of the five elements. Yes, for example—
choice_data_list: Make sure to plant your feet firmly.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right, like really digging your foot in. 
Look, just like this!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
See, by connecting more strongly with the 
earth, you can strengthen your legs and 
hips too, right? So...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-Well... that sort of thing might not be 
so bad. But...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It kinda seems half-baked, or whatever. 
It'd suck if it's wrong, so... see ya.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, like persevering and holding out 
longer. See, just like this!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—If you steady your breathing, you can 
even see ki. And your courage gets forged 
along with it, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-Well... that sort of thing might not be 
so bad. But...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It kinda seems half-baked, or whatever. 
It'd suck if it's wrong, so... see ya.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey now! I never said half-assed!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I get it. Maybe they don't 
believe me because they think I'm making a 
mistake."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
On that note, Acute-san's experiences are 
things that actually happened, so there's 
less room for error... right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, Acute-san, really~. I did it just 
like you told me, and it turned out to be 
a complete failure~."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. Sorry about that, then.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're wrong!! Trainer, even though 
Acute-san is wrong too!!

Even if advice is based on real 
experience, it's never a hundred percent 
foolproof. There's always a chance it 
could be wrong.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's not about what's right or wrong. It's 
just that nobody trusts me, while everyone 
trusts Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What am I missing? I'm genuinely wishing 
for everyone's happiness, too...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's true. Maybe we'll find out if 
we ask directly?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Acute-san, got a second?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the reason people believe in me? 
Well, let's see, basically—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Why would that be? Beats me~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, even Acute-san herself doesn't 
know...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm just reminiscing about the old 
days~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's about what I've personally 
experienced with my own body, and what 
I've felt.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So much has happened, hasn't it? After 
fighting so hard, I finally managed to run 
in the same race as Falco-san, who was 
strong as a red demon...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more. Just a tiny, tiny, 
tiny, tiny bit! That memorable race where 
I just barely failed to reach it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There were all kinds of Umamusume besides 
Falco-san, weren't there? A country girl, 
a girl who fell from the turf tracks...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected Cinderella story, followed 
by an out-of-this-world shocker. Man, it 
sure gave everyone quite a fright~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you were to tell a true Umamusume 
story like that just as it happened...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone just gathers around me for some 
reason. It's not like I'm particularly 
funny or anything, though."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All I can do is just share what we went 
through, laughing and crying side by side, 
just as it happened.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just as I've always lived my life... 
That's all it is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, right now... Trainer, I'm... 
right now..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was totally captivated listening to it. 
It made my heart beat so fast.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Why is this happening? How come...?"

I felt like I understood. This difference 
means, in other words—
choice_data_list: I guess it's a difference in trust levels.
Maybe it's a difference in trust levels.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Of the trust level...
choice_data_list:
Right, it resonates because it's a 
heartfelt story.

Right, it resonates because it's a 
heartfelt story.

text_block_list.text:
This isn't about right or wrong. An 
Umamusume bets her entire life on running 
a race.

That is why stories not born from actual 
experience aren't believed. Entrusting 
yourself to mere daydreams only leads to 
bitter regret.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Regular people believed in feng 
shui just because it was fun. But...”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Those who take it seriously are just 
different. Without the breath of life and 
a strong dragon vein backing them up, 
their words won't reach anyone...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's not about being simple, nor whether 
it's a hit or not. No matter how much 
effort you put into it...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
As I am right now, my feng shui won't 
reach them. Especially to someone who's 
genuinely struggling...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure what's going on, 
Ricky-chan, but don't rush yourself so 
much, alright?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ricky-chan is a good girl, so everything 
will surely work out. Someday, that is.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. Thank you, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I understand now. I finally get 
it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
An "unseen future" cannot triumph over a 
"visible past." If that's the case, then 
feng shui...

Her voice sounds a bit gloomy. Maybe she's 
feeling down, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“What can surpass the 『visible past』— is 
something else entirely.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You're right, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Um, what's something you can win at?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It is—the "now." A living moment about to 
unfold right before our eyes.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I demonstrate it right in front of them 
and prove the power of feng shui, everyone 
will believe me! Just like Ms. Acute did!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I must turn my own body into a compass— 
and point the way through the air 
currents!"

A cheerful expression paired with a 
piercing gaze. It was truly the brilliant 
gleam of a dragon's eye.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'll do it. I'll show you I can.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I won't tell you to hold back on racing 
anymore. These feelings, this passion, 
isn't meant for words—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll pour it purely into my running and 
prove it! So fiercely that it'll shake the 
soul of everyone watching!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Before the Champions Cup, I need to 
improve my running even more, and then—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll catch up to Tarumae, who's always 
been ahead of me! I'll prove that my feng 
shui is the real deal!
